authority.machine_semantics_source: this exact candidate JSON byte artifact
authority.oracle_role: fixture generation and independent byte recomputation only
authority.promotion: requires root decision, clean-room byte conformance, holdback agreement, and separate routing/model decisions

canonical_json.final_bytes: compact UTF-8 JSON plus exactly one LF
forbidden: ASCII escaping of directly encodable scalar
canonical_json.object_key_order: decoded key raw UTF-8 byte ascending, recursively
canonical_json.string_escape: quote/backslash; short escapes for 08,09,0a,0c,0d; other controls lowercase \u00xx

BAG_MULTISET.call_precondition: bound routing must prove at least one routed occurrence; otherwise NOT_QUALIFIED_CARDINALITY
BAG_MULTISET.routing_uniqueness_precondition: for each family, bag_child_context and base_stat, routing authorizes exactly one input channel; otherwise NOT_QUALIFIED_ROUTING_PRECONDITION
BAG_MULTISET.rule: sort exact rationals ascending; aggregate all values before emission; apply rational bounds to every derived output

CONTAINER_COUNT.rule: only a machine routing row can authorize this count; generic recursion cannot

ORDERED_SERIES.item_output: each item retains ORDERED(index) context, channel ORDERED_ITEM, and base_stat
ORDERED_SERIES.singleton: emit item plus all 13 summary stats; deltas and step counts are zero

category.atom: TVE2(value); MISSING uses reserved MISSING2 byte 07
category.atom_channel_invariant: channel=MISSING iff atom=MISSING2; violation is NOT_QUALIFIED_MISSING_ATOM_MISMATCH
category.emitted_count: 1..18446744073709551615; zero occurrences emit no row; checked-u64 overflow is NOT_QUALIFIED_COUNT_BOUNDS
category.missing_rule: channel=MISSING requires expected_channel != NONE; all nonmissing channels require expected_channel=NONE
category.occurrence_normalization: aggregate identical row_identity_term occurrences by checked-u64 addition before emission; duplicate rows in an emitted vector are NOT_QUALIFIED_DUPLICATE_CATEGORICAL_ROW
category.row_sha256: lowercase_hex(SHA256(row_preimage)); derived check value, not an additional predictor member
category.value_sha256: lowercase_hex(SHA256(typed_value_preimage)); this is the typed value digest, not the row hash

model_input.rule: no model may depend on this candidate until it binds exact primitives, routing, feature-vector schema, predictor bytes and audit bytes

outer_predictor_audit_pair.failure_state: NOT_QUALIFIED requires predictor_binding=null, no predictor bytes, and no outer pair; audit-only diagnostics remain classifier-ineligible
outer_predictor_audit_pair.rule: a QUALIFIED receipt-specific outer slot/leaf manifest must bind exact filename, length and sha256 for both artifacts; any mismatch is NOT_QUALIFIED_AUDIT_CROSS_FIELD

required_machine_claims: each BAG output numeric identity has exactly one authorized input channel
every scalar and active union leaf has exactly one include or exclude owner
categorical occurrences are passed before aggregation

semantic_validator.rule: standard JSON Schema is structural only; the bound provider source must implement the normative semantic rules and fail closed

exclusions.collector_path_routing: not decided by this primitives candidate
exclusions.model_layout_C01_C05: not decided by this primitives candidate
exclusions.receipt_schema: not decided by this primitives candidate

limits.max_decoded_input_bytes_unit: exact post-transport, pre-JSON-parse document bytes including whitespace and escape syntax
limits.max_json_depth_unit: inclusive root-to-value count; root is depth 1
limits.max_number_lexeme_bytes_unit: all ASCII bytes of the JSON number token including sign, dot, e/E and exponent sign/digits
limits.max_significand_digits_unit: all mantissa digits including leading and trailing zeroes; excludes signs, decimal point and exponent syntax

ngram.direct_output: aggregate by family and bucket only after route-aware hashing
ngram.truncation: length<=4096 one full span; otherwise bytes[0:2048] and bytes[len-2048:len] independently; no decode/repair and no cross-gap gram

numeric.derived_bounds: the 4864 magnitude-digit ceiling is reapplied after every sum, delta, interpolation and other derived operation before emission
numeric.digit_limit_sign: minus sign is not a digit and does not count toward the 4864 numerator/denominator magnitude-digit ceiling
numeric.exact_rational: parse JSON number token as decimal mathematical value; reduce gcd; denominator positive; all signed zero becomes 0/1
numeric.exponent_text: leading exponent zeroes are allowed and do not create a separate digit limit; compare the mathematical signed exponent to abs<=4096 without unbounded integer conversion
numeric.predictor_representation: numerator and denominator are canonical decimal strings; no JSON float
numeric.quantile_type7: exact rational h=(m-1)*p; linear interpolation; m=1 returns sole value; m=0 undefined
numeric.resource_failures: any number limit violation is NOT_QUALIFIED_NUMERIC_BOUNDS

output.categorical_sort: categorical row identity raw tuple ascending
output.predictor_audit_physical_separation: predictor contains no receipt/source/path/provenance/debug; audit sidecar binds predictor but predictor does not bind audit; external exact-pair binding is mandatory

raw_json_input.duplicate_key_boundary: parse exact raw JSON bytes with an order-preserving object-pairs callback; reject a repeated decoded key before conversion to a map
raw_json_input.invalid_utf8: reject any non-shortest or otherwise invalid raw UTF-8 before JSON parsing
raw_json_input.lone_surrogate: reject decoded strings or keys containing U+D800..U+DFFF

audit_cross_fields: routing_counts exactly equal checked-u64 included multiplicity sums by route
truncation spans exactly match full length and threshold
all bindings are verified by exact byte readback
qualified status has empty failure_codes and unknown_paths and an exact predictor binding
feature_vector: all arrays are strictly sorted and identity-unique
all counts and rational bounds are enforced numerically
bound routing family/channel/stat matrix accepts every row
MISSING channel/value bidirectional invariant was enforced before digesting

shape.truncated: 1 iff full raw UTF-8 byte length > 4096 else 0

tve2.object: 06||U32_BE(count)||FRAME32(key_utf8)||FRAME32(TVE2(value))... with keys raw-UTF8 ascending; duplicate key fails
